description: Comprehensive guide to association studies from GWAS to multi-omic analyses

topics.title: GWAS (Genome-Wide Association Studies)
topics.question: Which common variants contribute to disease?
memoryHooks: GWAS = 'Shotgun genome search with millions of gunshots'
Manhattan plot = 'If SNP is significant, it's a skyscraper'

commonErrors.error: Forgetting to correct for multiple testing
commonErrors.consequence: False positives (p < 0.05 for 1M SNPs → 50,000 false hits)

topics.title: Heritability Estimation (LDSC, GREML)
topics.question: How much of trait variation is due to genetics?
topics.focus: Quantifying genetic contribution to trait variance
topics.workflow: Genotype data → relatedness matrix → variance component estimation
memoryHooks: Heritability = proportion of variance due to genetics
LDSC uses summary statistics, GREML uses individual-level data

commonErrors.fix: h2 = VA/VP (additive genetic variance/total phenotypic variance)
